notes.en: Computer hardware includes the physical parts of a computer. This includes the Monitor, Keyboard, Mouse, and the System Unit (where the brain of the computer is). For mobile devices, the hardware includes the screen, battery, and internal chips.
notes.rw: Ibice by'imashini (hardware) bikubiyemo ibice bifatika byayo. Ibi bikubiyemo 'Monitor' (aho urebera), 'Keyboard' (aho wandikira), 'Mouse', n'agasanduku k'imashini (ari naho hari ubwonko bwayo). Ku bikoresho ngendanwa, hardware ikubiyemo ecran (screen), batiri, n'ibindi bice by'imbere.

notes.en: The Operating System (OS) is the software that manages all other software and hardware. Examples include Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. Files are used to store data, and folders are used to organize files.
notes.rw: Operating System (OS) ni porogaramu igenzura izindi porogaramu zose n'ibice by'imashini. Ingero ni Windows, macOS, Android, na iOS. Dosiye (files) zikoreshwa mu kubika amakuru, naho amadosiye (folders) akoreshwa mu gutunganya izo dosiye.
